headline: The oops becomes the story
fortune: A small mistake will become the funniest part of your day, and nobody will be upset—not even the samosa.

headline: You pause at the perfect second
fortune: You will stop one hasty reply, take a breath, and send the kinder version. Future-you owes you a laddoo.

headline: Plan B brings snacks
fortune: Your backup plan will work better than the original and somehow include better food. Plan A may file a complaint.

headline: The wrong turn has jalebi
fortune: A wrong turn leads you past a tiny shop frying fresh jalebi. The lane refuses to apologize, and neither should you.

headline: The dal forgives you
fortune: A meal you nearly oversalt is rescued before anyone notices. Accept the praise with the calm of a seasoned magician.

headline: The missed ride brings company
fortune: You miss one ride and meet someone you have not seen in years. Being late arrives with excellent conversation.

headline: The tear becomes the best part
fortune: A small tear gets a bright patch and turns an old favorite into a better favorite. Even clothes enjoy second chances.

headline: The mix-up tastes wonderful
fortune: Your order arrives slightly wrong and unexpectedly delicious. A new favorite enters through the side door.

headline: Three honest words soften everything
fortune: You say “I was wrong” before pride can interfere. The room gets warmer, and so does the friendship.

headline: The burnt roti wins a fan
fortune: One roti comes out shaped like a distant continent. Everyone laughs, and the hungriest person asks for it.

headline: The picnic moves indoors
fortune: Rain sends everyone home, so the picnic happens on the floor instead. Somehow the laughter fits better there.

headline: The haircut stops arguing
fortune: A haircut you doubted settles beautifully after one wash. The mirror withdraws its earlier complaint.

headline: The awkward moment becomes a joke
fortune: You forget a name, admit it, and both of you laugh. By the end of the conversation, you will not forget it again.
